meta.purpose: Rules for deciding which discovered event candidates can be auto-published and which require human review.
meta.principle: AI extraction + an independent AI verifier pass is the trust mechanism, not source type. Objective fact checks (missing fields, past dates, duplicates) are a hard floor no confidence score can override. Anything that doesn't clear both goes to a GitHub Issue for human review, not a silently-updated PR.

aiVerification.notes: Auto-publish requires: passes hardFloor AND verify.mjs's independent confidence >= autoPublishConfidenceThreshold. Source type is no longer a gate by default -- see sourceOverrides for exceptions learned over time. Lowered from 0.9 to 0.8 on 2026-08-11 alongside a verify.mjs prompt fix for confidence miscalibration (real production data: across two full runs, nothing ever scored above 0.8 even for candidates with no concrete error, because the verifier was inventing its own completeness standards and padding non-issues into the concerns list). Revisit this number once a few runs confirm genuinely clean candidates now score in the 0.9-1.0 range as intended.

sourceOverrides.notes: Source ids listed here always route to human review regardless of verifier confidence -- an escape hatch for sources that have proven unreliable, without having to touch decide.mjs. visit-korcula-racisce added 2026-08-16: across 3 separate runs its 'Other events' section (Moreska, chess/robotics/art/drama workshops, KUL quiz -- all really Korcula-town programs already covered by kt-moreska-season and kt-ljeto-u-knjiznici) kept getting extracted as new Racisce-town events with high enough confidence to auto-publish. Revisit once the extraction prompt fixes for this page have proven out over a few review-only runs.
